title: Clinical Record De-identification
description: Automatically de-identify clinical notes, discharge summaries, and care plans by redacting PHI for quality improvement, training, or case studies.

title: Research Data Preparation
description: Redact patient identifiers from medical documents to create de-identified datasets for research studies, clinical trials, and publications while maintaining HIPAA compliance.

title: Insurance Claims Redaction
description: Remove sensitive patient data from insurance claims, prior authorization requests, and billing documentation before external sharing.

title: Patient Portal Protection
description: Redact sensitive provider notes and third-party information from medical records before sharing with patients through patient portals.

title: Legal & Compliance Redaction
description: Redact PHI from medical records prepared for legal proceedings, malpractice cases, or regulatory investigations while preserving relevant clinical data.

title: Quality Improvement De-identification
description: De-identify patient data in clinical datasets used for quality improvement initiatives, outcome analysis, and population health studies.
